_comment: Saved region groups for model.py, so a manager can run their own spots
with one short command:   python model.py --group jdoe
Edit the 'groups' block below. The key is whatever you want to type after
--group (a manager's name, a team, an initiative). The value is the list of
Region names are matched loosely, so 'North East', 'northeast' and
'Northeast' all work. Run  python model.py --list-regions  to see what
folders exist, and  python model.py --list-groups  to see what is defined
The entries below are placeholders - rename them to your actual managers.
